claim: Schauenstein offers 12 named rooms/suites split across the castle, Seidenhaus and Meierhaus; rates run CHF 610–1,070 incl. breakfast
quote: Suite Feuer CHF 840 ... Room Linde CHF 610 ... Suite Luft CHF 1,070 (plus CHF 250 for tower bedroom). All prices include breakfast and applicable taxes.

claim: Schauenstein is a historic castle in Graubünden with nine unique rooms and three-Michelin-star cuisine by Andreas Caminada
quote: Schloss Schauenstein in Fürstenau is a historic castle in Graubünden with nine unique rooms and award-winning cuisine by top Swiss chef Andreas Caminada.

claim: Casa Caminada in Fürstenau (Obergass 3) has ten unique rooms in larch wood with on-site restaurant, bakery and concept store
quote: ten rooms, each a unique creation ... calm lines and sensual larch wood ... bakery (Pasternaria), and an Atelier Caminada concept store

claim: Casa Caminada is a 300-year-old barn-and-stable conversion designed by Spanish hospitality designer Patricia Urquiola, adjacent to Schloss Schauenstein
quote: the 300-year-old barn and stable has been thoroughly transformed into a stylish, contemporary boutique hotel, designed by the Spanish hospitality expert Patricia Urquiola

claim: Hotel Weiss Kreuz Thusis is a third-generation family hotel founded in 1848 at the foot of Piz Beverin and the Viamala
quote: The family hotel was founded in 1848 ... now in its third generation of family business

claim: Hotel Fravi Andeer occupies a building from 1828 owned by the Fravi family since construction, with direct access to the Mineralbad Andeer (1,800 m² wellness)
quote: located in a historic building from 1828 ... The Fravi family have owned the house since its construction in 1828 ... Mineralbad Andeer, a wellness oasis of approximately 1,800 m², is directly connected to the hotel

claim: Hotel Bodenhaus Splügen has hosted Nietzsche (16 years running from 1872), Einstein, Turner, Andersen and Napoleon III; rooms are named after famous guests
quote: philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche (who stayed annually for 16 years starting in 1872), physicist Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen ... landscape painter William Turner, and Napoleon III ... Rooms are named after famous guests like Einstein and Nietzsche

claim: Hotel Capricorns sits in Wergenstein inside Beverin Nature Park; the 2011 renovation preserved its 1930s room furnishings; geothermal heat and local hydropower
quote: sensitively renovated during the summer months in 2011 ... ambience of the rooms with their original furnishings from the nineteen-thirties could be kept ... geothermal energy sources or electricity from local hydropower

claim: Hotel Weiss Kreuz Splügen is a restored 1375 carrier inn; 15 rooms at CHF 125–145 per person; original arven panelling, stone vaults, traditional stoves
quote: The building dates to 1375 ... 15 guest rooms vary in size (15–40 m²) ... Rooms range from CHF 125–145 per person, with single accommodations at CHF 140

claim: Hotel Alte Herberge Weiss Kreuz Splügen received an Icomos award in 2002 for its restoration and joined Swiss Historic Hotels in 2005
quote: The hotel received an Icomos award in 2002 for its extremely careful restoration work and joined Swiss Historic Hotels in 2005. Famous historical guests reportedly included Goethe and Grimm.

claim: Berggasthaus Beverin on the Glaspass is a ~400-year-old mountain inn at 1,880 m with original plank floors and a tiled-stove parlour; 30 beds in double and multi-bed rooms
quote: Lovingly furnished rooms with old plank floors bear witness to the almost four hundred year history of the house ... 30 beds in double and multi-bed rooms ... Glaspass ... 1,880 meters elevation

claim: Hotel Stern Chur is a 4-star Swiss Historic hotel in Chur's old town with arven-wood interior and the 14-GaultMillau-point Bündner Stube restaurant
quote: only quality full service 4-star swiss historic hotel in Chur ... Completely decorated in typical Arvenholz ... 'Bündner Stube' - boasting 14 Gault Millau points

claim: The core of Hotel Stern Chur dates to 1677, when it was the Gasthaus zum Stern with its own merchant stables
quote: The core of the current building has been dated at 1677; at that time, the hotel was known as the Gasthaus zum Stern

claim: Chur to Fürstenau is 24–25 km by road, ~19 minutes by car; hourly train Chur–Cazis (37 min) is the closest rail route
quote: The route spans 24 km by direct measurement, though the road distance is 25.1 km ... Approximately 19 minutes by car ... The train from Chur to Cazis takes 37 min

claim: Splügen received the Swiss Heritage Society's Wakker Prize in 1995 and joined the Most Beautiful Villages of Switzerland in 2019
quote: In 1995, the Swiss Heritage Society bestowed the Wakker Prize to Splügen ... in 2019, it joined the 'Most Beautiful Villages of Switzerland' association

claim: Hotel Capricorns is reached via Thusis (14.1 km away), eight daily bus connections from Andeer; mineral baths in Andeer are 8 km from the hotel
quote: The nearest train station is Thusis, located 14.1 km away ... The mineral baths in Andeer are 8 km from the hotel ... eight daily bus connections from Andeer

claim: Berggasthaus Beverin is reached via a 15 km winding mountain road to the Glaspass and faces the 2,998 m Piz Beverin
quote: accessible via a 15 km winding mountain road to the Glaspass at 1,880 meters ... at the foot of Piz Beverin

claim: Taxi Elsa operates taxi service across Thusis and Chur, covering the Domleschg area
quote: Taxi Elsa in Thusis und Chur

claim: Schauenstein offers a complimentary transfer from Thusis train station for hotel guests, alongside free bicycle rental
quote: Free bicycle rental and complimentary transfer from/to Thusis train station are available
